faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Utkal University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026, and candidates report at 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Utkal University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Laboratory Assistant-cum-Storekeeper.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Utkal University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 at 2:00 PM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 15,000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M. Sc. in Applied Microbiology / Microbiology.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA is permissible for appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and tenure based. Temporary for the Academic Session 2026-27. For the Self-financed Course M. Sc. Applied Microbiology as per SFC guidelines of the University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: P.G. Department of Botany, Utkal University, Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All original mark sheets and certificates in support of educational qualifications with a set of photocopies; Bio-Data / Curriculum Vitae; Experience certificate (if any); 02 passport size photographs.
